## Hypothesis

SNIPER_VIX_TREND_OOS_CONFIRMED is a new trade class that combines the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup with a VIX-trend regime filter, aiming to capture the edge in escalating VIX environments. The hypothesis is that this combination can produce a positive edge capture, improving the overall performance of the engine.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves the following components:

1. SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup: This setup looks for a level break in the SPY price, followed by a retest of the broken level.
2. VIX-trend regime filter: This filter checks if the VIX is in an escalating trend, using a 5-day moving average as a reference point.
3. Entry and exit logic: The entry logic involves buying a call option when the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup fires and the VIX-trend regime filter confirms an escalating trend. The exit logic involves selling the call option when the trade reaches a predetermined profit target or stops out at a loss.
